Facilitation; Productowner

Stellenbeschreibung:
Programme & Community Developer Berlin · 32–36 hrs/week · Starting September/October 2026 or by arrangement · fixed on-site times: 3–4 evenings + 1 weekend day

⚠️ Important – please read first: This position is funded exclusively through § 16e SGB II. You can only apply if you meet this funding requirement: **at least 21 of the last 24 months receiving Jobcenter benefits (Bürgergeld/SGB II).**Please note: time with the Agentur für Arbeit (unemployment benefit / Arbeitslosengeld I) does NOT count – only benefits received through the Jobcenter count. If you're unsure whether you qualify, it's best to check quickly with your Jobcenter contact before applying.

About ForEveryone ForEveryone is a non-profit social enterprise in Berlin. We bring people from different backgrounds together, among other things through our community café at Boxhagener Platz and through workshops, events and activities for an international Berlin audience. We are growing, and we are currently reshaping our whole range of activities.

What this role is about We are looking for someone to oversee, develop and be present across our whole range of activities – from workshops to events at our community café at Boxhagener Platz (jam sessions, music nights, exhibitions and more). The clear goal: turning individual activities into recurring small communities with their own memberships. Instead of activities we have to market and fill again every time, we want formats people come back to regularly – a knitting club, a sports format, creative combinations, a recurring music night. You drive this: you sense what the community wants, develop formats to match, test them, run them yourself, recruit and support the volunteers who help carry them, and make sure the good ones actually happen and grow.

What you'll do

- Oversee and support the offering. You keep an eye on all running activities – workshops and café events alike – are regularly present on site, and make sure everything runs smoothly, including the operational side in our booking tool (cancellations, refunds, correct details) – a small but important part of the week.
- Develop and test formats and events. You sense what activities the community wants, identify new workshop, event and mini-formats, research trends and seasonal demand (what are others offering, what works in a summer lull?), and honestly test which formats land well enough to sustain, and which don't.
- Build mini-communities with memberships. You develop formats with recurring communities in mind – ones people belong to as members – and take them from first idea to an established, recurring offering.
- Run activities and enable volunteers. You run workshops and events yourself on a regular basis, at a good standard – weekly, sometimes with support from volunteers. You recruit volunteers (including from among participants), onboard them, give them direct feedback, and support them until they can carry a format.
- Guide formats through their phases. For new formats: experiment and learn from feedback. For established ones: set up clean processes, with reliability and scaling in mind.

What you bring

- Experience running workshops, events, groups or community formats, at a quality others can build on.
- A feel for people and communities, and enjoyment in recruiting and supporting volunteers.
- Conceptual strength: you can develop formats, test them, and judge honestly what works.
- Self-direction and ownership – you drive your area like a genuine project lead.
- Fixed on-site times: at least 3–4 evenings per week (around 2–3 hours each, within the 5–10 pm window) plus 1 day at the weekend (Saturday or Sunday, daytime or evening). These are your core working hours. The rest of your time you can arrange flexibly from the office. This on-site presence comes with a lot of creative freedom, but it is also a clear expectation.
- Comfortable with digital tools; German and English are a strong plus for our multilingual community.

What to expect from us

- A role with real room to shape things: you are building something that doesn't exist yet.
- A small, committed team and real closeness to a lively, international community.
- We set the strategic and financial direction (e.g. the membership model) as managing directors; you develop and decide on the formats independently, with our final sign-off.

Terms

- Hours: 32–36 per week
- Start: September/October 2026 or by arrangement
- Pay: €2,400–2,800 gross/month (at 36 hrs)
- Location: Coworking Kiezlab, Berlin · hybrid

Summary

Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Floor-planning in collaboration with RF IC design and RF system team. The layout of RF, analog, and digital blocks for RF ICs down to the transistor level. Block-level and top-level layout through full verification flow. Top-level layout integration, verification, and schedule management. Work with packaging experts to simulate RF de-sense and coupling mechanisms. Layout reviews for routing, signal path, IQ matching, and coupling.

- Knowledge of CADENCE layout tools

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, and a minimum of 3 years relevant industry experience

- Proven understanding of RF building blocks such as LNAs, mixers, VCOs, DCOs, PAs, etc.

Summary

At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? Do you like changing the game? As a member of our PMU team at our Nabern office close to Stuttgart, you will have the great opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers every day! We are looking for an AMS Verification Engineer who will enable us to verify our next generation of PMUs, in close collaboration with the design teams. The responsibilities include contributing to the top level verification of our PMUs. A number of IP specific features as well as interaction between IPs will also be part of the expected verification scope.

Description

- In this role, you will take care of ensuring high quality silicon for IC chips and IPs. The workflow starts with careful review of specifications followed by crafting of a verification plan and schedule. Then the verification is executed according to plan to support tape-out. - Execution of verification plans from beginning to end: test bench and environment bring-up, regressions, failure debug, and tape-out - Develop detailed test and coverage plans based on IC specifications - Develop verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring scalability and portability - Develop verification environment, including stimuli, checkers, assertions, trackers, and coverage - Sign-off mixed signal designs in preparation for tape-out.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelors in EE or related field, or equivalent work experience
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, combined with the ability to collaborate
- Ability to work well on a team, take ownership and motivate self and others
- Fluent English skills

Preferred Qualifications

- Advanced knowledge of mixed signal verification
- Few years of experience in industry for production integrated circuits.
- Experience with developments in hardware descriptive languages: Verilog, System-Verilog, and/or Verilog-AMS code.
- A background that includes scripting or programming languages is preferred. These include, but are not limited to, TCL, Skill, Python, and/or PERL.
- Familiar with analog behavioural models
- Familiar with verification methodologies and tools: simulators, waveform viewers, execution automation, coverage collection, experience developing scalable and portable test cases
- Possess sufficient analog IC background to identify failure possibilities, work through first order debug, and analyse analog verification results
- Knowledge of analog concurrent assertion and static analyses checks is a plus
- Understanding of both power management and related auxiliary circuitry: switching converters, linear converters, reference circuitry, band-gaps, data converters, and clock generators

jobs.description:
Summary

Would you like to be part of Apple’s fast-growing RF wireless design team in Munich? We are responsible for all aspects of wireless silicon development with a particular emphasis on highly integrated, power efficient designs and advanced semiconductor technologies that enable an outstanding user experience. IC design engineers work on circuit and system solutions for sophisticated wireless chips. This is a highly visible role in a fast growing silicon design group where you'll have the opportunity to make a critical impact on getting innovative consumer products to a global customer base quickly!

Description

As a RF Design Engineer at Apple, you will use your vast background in circuit design and provide PLL design solutions for wireless chips. You will collaborate with platform architects, system group, and digital design group to define the requirements for a PLL lineup based on the product requirements. You will also work with the Apple technology team and silicon foundries on process evaluation/selection for the target device. Design tasks include various analog biasing blocks, oscillators, frequency dividers and local oscillator chains. You will work with system engineering, layout, and chip integration teams to integrate the IP’s and verify the top-level functionality and performance. You also will work with RF test engineers to bring up, characterize and optimize new silicon.

Minimum Qualifications

- Profound experience in RF circuit design techniques.
- Experience with Cadence design tools.
- EM modelling and simulation skills.
- MSEE /PhD or equivalent is required.
- Proficiency in English is required.

Preferred Qualifications

- A proven track record in RF, and analog integrated circuit design, with experience in wireless PLL circuit architectures in CMOS technologies.
- Deep understanding in PLL system specifications and the ability to work with system architects to translate system requirements into circuit requirements at IC block level. 
- Knowledge in fundamental RF theories and concepts, such as innovative PLL concepts and their trade-offs in key performance parameters (KPI’s), area and power efficiency.
- The ability to optimize the overall PLL system including EVM, blocker requirements and crosstalk mitigations.
- Deep technical knowledge in analysis, design, and implementation of RF wireless low-noise, broadband and power efficient PLLs, as well as frequency converting blocks.
- Extensive experience in simulation of RF analog key building blocks, such as oscillators, frequency dividers, phase detectors and local oscillator signal distribution chains
- Solid experience in optimization of RF circuit design impairments by means of highly sophisticated methods of trimming and calibration 
- Experience in RF cross talk analysis, understanding the critical RF cross talk building laws and the according aggressor and victim analysis, translation of RF system KPI's into IC block level isolation requirements 
- Understanding of RF device modelling, insights into packaging effects, integrated coils, supply isolations, high frequency ESD structures, and circuit layout for optimum performance.
- Hands-on experience in high frequency silicon characterization and debugging on chip as well as on system level.

The role connects Project Delivery, Corporate IT and external partners to deliver measurable business value.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Define and manage the product vision, roadmap, priorities and investment portfolio for EPC Project Delivery.
- Translate common needs across Project Management, Project Controls, Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning into scalable product capabilities and measurable outcomes.
- Own portfolio lifecycle decisions, including investment, improvement, consolidation, replacement and retirement.
- Ensure products are successfully delivered, adopted, integrated, secure, reliable and supportable.
- Manage product budgets, service performance, licenses, risks, vendors and delivery partners.
- Lead the product team and establish effective governance across business stakeholders, Corporate IT and external partners.

Show your expertise

- 8+ years of experience managing digital products, enterprise applications, or technology-enabled business capabilities within EPC, engineering, construction, or comparable capital-project environments.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Project Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), experience with Primavera, SAP, RIB, SharePoint, or comparable platforms is an advantage.
- Strong expertise in product and application portfolio management, including strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, investment decisions, and lifecycle management.
- Solid understanding of EPC project delivery and construction business processes, including areas such as planning, project controls, cost management, construction, or information management.
- Good knowledge of solution architecture, systems integration, data management, cybersecurity, and IT service management.
- Commercially minded leader with experience managing budgets, software licensing, sourcing, vendor performance, and total cost of ownership.
- Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, influence international stakeholders, and drive technology-enabled transformation.
Fluency in English is required, German language skills are considered a strong advantage.

jobs.occupation: Environmental Test Technician (AIT) (m/f/d) (Techniker/in - Luftfahrttechnik/Bachelor Professional in Technik)
jobs.description:
Akkodis is a global digital engineering consulting company that brings together technology and talent to accelerate transformation, drive innovation, and shape a smarter future. With more than 40,000 experts across over 30 countries, we connect industries and technologies - from AI and data analytics to cloud, edge computing, automation and cybersecurity.

Kundendetails

We are currently seeking a talented professional to join our team in Munich for an exciting project with one of our clients in the aerospace industry.

Stellenbeschreibung

- Execute thermal-vacuum and thermal cycling tests on spaceflight hardware
- Develop and implement environmental test procedures in collaboration with Test Leads
- Monitor, control and evaluate environmental test campaigns
- Maintain thermal-vacuum chambers and associated test equipment
- Define test processes and environmental test facility configurations
- Support the specification of environmental test equipment in collaboration with engineering teams
- Analyze test results and prepare technical reports
- Create and maintain procedures, work instructions and operational standards

Profil

- 3-5 years of experience in AIT, environmental testing or laboratory operations, preferably in the aerospace industry
- Experience with thermal cycling, thermal-vacuum testing and precision metrology
- Knowledge of space standards, environmental test setups and spacecraft qualification testing
- Proven ability to develop, execute and report environmental test campaigns
- Hands-on experience with metrology equipment such as CMMs and laser trackers
- Strong understanding of spaceflight hardware and environmental test requirements
- Willingness to work shifts and occasional weekends
- Fluent in English; German is an advantage

Das Angebot

- Team spirit and diversity
- Work-life balance
- Attractive compensation
- Employee benefits
- A wide range of training and development opportunities
- Team and sports events
- Global network
- Attractive employee referral program

Benefits may vary depending on the position and location. An overview of our benefits can be found on our website under the "Careers and Benefits" section.

Are you passionate about transforming data into powerful insights and driving smarter business decisions?

KWS Berlin GmbH is looking for a Data Analyst with focus on Source-to-Pay (m/w/d) who is keen on translating business requirements into analytics solutions and operating and optimizing data pipelines with strong governance and Master Data standards. This position is unlimited and available on a full-time basis (38 hours/week) in Berlin.

Your Responsibilities:

- Translate business requirements into analytics solutions and collaborate across the full project lifecycle.
- Operate and optimize data pipelines (ERP, S2P suite, AP, vendor master) with strong governance and master data management standards.
- Perform diagnostic and predictive analyses to identify value levers (e.g., price/volume variance, payment term optimization).
- Partner with cross-functional teams to define KPI standards, maintain data dictionaries, and ensure a single source of truth.
- Support process mining and advanced analytics use cases (e.g., Celonis) to uncover inefficiencies.
- Monitor and manage the Source-to-Pay (S2P) analytics landscape for stability, scalability, and compliance.
- Drive adoption and change management for analytics solutions across S2P.
- Build functional analytics capabilities within the S2P organization.

Your profile:

- Bachelor’s degree in Analytics, Economics, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
- Proven experience in Procurement, Finance, Source-to-Pay (S2P), or Spend Analytics environments.
- Experience with Master Data Management (MDM), data governance frameworks, and data quality monitoring.
- Solid understanding of Source-to-Pay processes and familiarity with SAP S/4HANA.
- Experience working with large datasets and translating business requirements into scalable analytics solutions.
- Desirable experience in Power Apps, Power Automate and SAP Ariba.
- Proficiency in BI tools (Power BI, SAP SAC, Datasphere) and process mining (Celonis).
- Strong SQL skills; Python or R is a plus.
- Strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and proactive approach.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.

Our offer:

- We are an international team of open-minded people with diverse and cross-functional experience;
- Interesting and challenging tasks and projects;
- As a family business, we are guided by the values of closeness, reliability, vision and independence; this culture is lived in practice and ensures an open and friendly working atmosphere from day one;
- The best of both worlds: KWS Berlin combines the security of a large, stable company with the passion of a start-up;
- Our location in the heart of Berlin-Schöneberg is very modern; directly opposite the underground station Bülowstraße and with secured car & bicycle parking spaces;
- We offer 30d holidays, flexible working hours, holiday and Christmas bonuses, company pension scheme, JobRad and/or Jobticket;
- True to our motto "Make yourself grow", we support the professional and personal development of our employees.

We look forward to receiving your online application via our application system SuccessFactors! Please use the "Apply" function in the online advertisement.

We shape trust in the digital age!
At G+D, we are creating confidence, with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. To our customers, we have been a reliable partner for more than 170 years. With our offering, we are well positioned to support them on their future journey. Discover our innovative SecurityTech solutions!
With our cash management and cash logistics solutions, G+D is driving the digital transformation of the global cash cycle. As a leading provider in this market, we support central banks, commercial banks, and cash-in-transit companies worldwide with innovative, secure, and highly reliable solutions.
As a Java Developer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing our mission-critical cash management and logistics platforms. You will contribute to the development of secure, scalable, and high-performance enterprise applications based on Java technologies, with a strong focus on the Spring ecosystem and modern software engineering practices.
In addition, you will help shape the future of software development at G+D by leveraging AI-assisted development tools and approaches. Working closely with your team, you will explore how coding assistants and AI agents can be used effectively, responsibly, and securely to improve productivity, software quality, testing, and documentation.
This role is based in Munich and offers the opportunity to work in a highly international environment. You will collaborate daily with an agile Scrum team primarily located in Gurugram, India, making strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset essential. If you enjoy working across cultures and contributing to globally distributed teams, we look forward to meeting you.

Your Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based enterprise applications with a strong focus on security, performance, scalability, and maintainability
- Contribute to technical design decisions, effort estimations, and architectural discussions
- Develop proof-of-concepts to evaluate and validate technical solutions and new technologies
- Collaborate closely with business analysts, testers, support specialists, and fellow developers throughout the software development lifecycle
- Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues and production incidents
- Apply and promote AI-assisted software development practices, ensuring responsible usage and validation of AI-generated results
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of our cross-functional agile team, fostering engineering excellence, built-in quality, test-driven development, security-by-design, and AI-first approaches
- Support knowledge sharing and actively contribute to a culture of continuous learning and innovation

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of professional experience in Java software development
- Strong expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA, EJB, and RESTful APIs
- Experience with enterprise application servers such as WebSphere or JBoss
- Solid understanding of object-oriented design principles, software architecture, and enterprise application development
- Hands-on experience with non-functional requirements, including security, performance optimization, scalability, and automated testing
- Experience with relational databases such as Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization and performance tuning
- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and a strong understanding of responsible AI usage, security considerations, and result validation
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
- Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment

jobs.occupation: Head of Global Business Operations (m/f/d) (Leiter/in - Operationsdienst)
jobs.description:
Drive Operational Excellence. Create Business Value. Shape Global Transformation.

At KWS, we are transforming the way global business services create value for our organization. As Head of Global Business Operations (GBO) (m/f/d), you will have the unique opportunity to shape a globally integrated operating model, drive digital transformation at scale, and partner directly with the CFO to enhance efficiency, service excellence, and business performance worldwide.

You will lead KWS' GBO organization with end-to-end accountability for our core administrative processes, including Record-to-Report (R2R), Source-to-Pay (S2P), and Order-to-Cash (O2C), ensuring operational excellence, scalability, and sustainable value creation across the enterprise.

Your Responsibilities:

Lead Global Business Operations

- Define and execute the strategic direction of Global Business Operations in alignment with KWS' business objectives.
- Lead a high-performing global organization with accountability for service delivery, operational performance, quality, and continuous improvement.
- Serve as a trusted partner to the CFO and senior business leaders, driving organizational effectiveness and business value.
- Own and Optimize End-to-End Processes - Provide global ownership and continuous improvement for key business processes: Record-to-Report (R2R), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C)
- You will establish clear governance structures, accountabilities, service standards, and performance expectations across functions, countries, and systems to ensure scalable and efficient process execution.

Drive Service Excellence and Business Performance

- Deliver reliable, high-quality services following a “first time right” approach.
- Define and manage KPIs, SLAs, and performance dashboards to drive transparency and accountability.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, and simplify processes.
- Generate actionable insights that support informed decision-making and business performance.

Lead Digital Transformation

- Drive the adoption of SAP S/4HANA, automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and AI-enabled technologies.
- Partner closely with Digital & IT, Global Process Owners, and business stakeholders to standardize processes and improve data quality.
- Develop and execute a transformation roadmap that balances innovation with operational stability.

Ensure Governance, Compliance and Risk Management

- Maintain a robust control environment across all GBO processes.
- Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards.
- Drive process transparency, accountability, and effective risk management across the end-to-end value chain.

Build a Future-Ready Organization

- Inspire, develop, and empower a global leadership team.
- Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability building.
- Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer orientation, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Budget and Resource Management

- Own the annual budget and strategic priorities for the GBO.
- Ensure efficient allocation of resources and delivery of operational and financial targets.
- Evaluate and sponsor business cases supporting service enhancements and transformation initiatives.

Your Profile:

Professional Experience

- Advanced degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Operations Management, or a related field.
- Significant leadership experience in Global Business Operations, Shared Services, Finance Operations, Procurement, Order Management, or comparable functions.
- Proven track record in leading large-scale operational and transformation initiatives within international organizations.
- Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes, particularly R2R, S2P, and OTC.
- Experience with SAP S/4HANA and digital transformation, automation, analytics, or AI-enabled solutions.
- Demonstrated success in leading within complex global matrix organizations.

Leadership Competencies

- Strategic and operational leader with a strong service and quality mindset.
- Ability to translate business priorities into scalable operational solutions.
- Strong analytical and fact-based decision-making skills.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing capabilities.
- Proven ability to drive transformation while maintaining operational excellence.
- Inclusive leadership style with a focus on trust, accountability, and people development.

Languages

- Fluent in English.
- German and additional languages are an advantage.

What We Offer:

- A highly visible and strategic leadership role with global responsibility.
- Direct partnership with the CFO and senior leadership team.
- Significant influence on the future development of KWS’ global operating model.
- The opportunity to shape process excellence, digital transformation, and organizational effectiveness on a global scale.
- An international, collaborative, and innovative working environment with substantial scope for impact and leadership.

We welcome applications from leaders who are ready to drive performance and transformation at scale. We look forward to receiving your application!
